name: Problem → Agitate → Solve (pain stack)

hook.visual: The problem in progress — not the happy ending
hook.audio_or_vo: Name the costly mistake or delay in one sentence
hook.text_overlay: The costly outcome, not the product name
hook.pattern_interrupt: Show consequence first (rust, downtime, invoice, empty bay)

beats.vo_or_copy: Time, money, reputation, safety — pick two and make them vivid

beats.visual: Expert or process shot that reveals the hidden cause
beats.vo_or_copy: Most people treat the symptom; the real issue is X
Here’s the correct sequence — short, numbered, memorable

cta.on_screen: Book a diagnosis / free assessment / quote
cta.spoken_or_caption: If you’re dealing with [problem], start with [low-friction step]
cta.landing_promise: Same problem language in headline; form asks for the painful detail

audio_design.music_energy: Tension bed under agitation; resolve on the solution beat
audio_design.vo_pace: Slightly urgent until solution, then calm and clear
audio_design.captions: Emphasize cost words and the 3-step labels

visual_system.lighting: Honest workshop / office light; avoid fake gloom
visual_system.editing_pace: Faster cuts in agitation; slower in process
visual_system.text_style: Numbered steps large enough to read muted

why_it_works: Agitation creates urgency without fake scarcity
Cause-reframe positions expertise before the offer
Numbered process is memorable and screenshot-friendly
anti_patterns: Jumping to CTA before the process is clear
metrics_signals: High outbound CTR on problem-matched audiences
Qualified lead form answers that restate the agitation
Watch time past the reframe beat

prompt_seeds.script: 35s PAS ad. Open on consequence. Agitate with two second-order costs. Reframe cause. Deliver 3-step process. CTA = book diagnosis.
prompt_seeds.shot_list: Consequence → cost montage → expert reframe → step1/2/3 → CTA card
prompt_seeds.image_gen: Documentary still of the problem consequence in a real workspace, no text, no logo

source_notes: Classic direct-response structure adapted for short video; pattern only.
